newsitem.title: NEPAL: At least 19 killed in Nepal bus, jeep collision.
newsitem.headline: At least 19 killed in Nepal bus, jeep collision.

text.p: At least 19 people were killed when a crowded passenger bus and a jeep collided in central Nepal on Wednesday, a Home (Interior) Ministry spokesman said.
The crash occurred in Kuringhat town in Chitaun district, 100 km (62 miles) west of the Nepali capital, the spokesman said.
At least 15 people died on the spot and four in hospital, he said. No other details were immediately available.
